- **Summary**: Du et al.  introduced AflIot, a coverage-guided greybox fuzzing framework customized for IoT devices operating on the Linux platform. AflIot's effectiveness was validated through comprehensive evaluations involving benchmarking and real-world testing scenarios, demonstrating its capability to detect vulnerabilities effectively in IoT environments.
